title: Famine aftermath deepens rural crisis
detail: The social and economic aftershocks of wartime scarcity and famine intensified grievances among poor peasants and sharecroppers in Bengal.

title: Demand for tebhaga becomes organized rural campaign
detail: Sharecroppers in several districts mobilized around the demand that cultivators retain two-thirds of the crop and store produce in their own granaries.

title: Confrontations with landlords and state repression
detail: Local confrontations, arrests, and coercive responses followed as jotedar interests and authorities attempted to contain the movement.

title: Tebhaga leaves durable agrarian-political legacy
detail: Although fragmented by partition-era transition, Tebhaga shaped later East Bengal and West Bengal debates on peasant rights, tenancy, and land reform politics.
